name: SCOUT Flood Depth 2050-2080 without NbS
description: Projected flood depth in metres for 2050 to 2080 without nature-based solutions (NbS), from SCOUT's Quad Cities flood projections. A cell with no depth holds no value. A 320 by 320 cell crop of SCOUT's 2050_2080_noNbS_4326_cropped.tif on its own grid (EPSG:4326, cells of 0.000101 degrees), longitude -90.4869 to -90.4544 and latitude 41.4377 to 41.4702: the area the FloodScenarios test dataflow reads. From SCOUT, https://github.com/urban-toolkit/scout, backend/compute/quad_city_flooding_simulation/data_substitutes, used with the permission of SCOUT's authors.
